item.title: Lean Product Management
item.description:
“Uncertainty” isn’t just a word for; it’s a state of existence for any product manager.

We have uncertainty about our customers and whether they’ll buy and use our products, our business partners and what strings they’ll pull to push their initiatives forward, and our marketplace of competition and ever-changing services and costs.

With so much uncertainty, how could any product team know precisely what it is they need to build to be successful?

item.title: Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)
item.description:
Write great OKRs to align teams around what really matters: the customer.

Objectives and Key Results, (OKRs) are first and foremost a goal-setting framework. They are simple and powerful, but to get the most out of OKRs, you must learn how to write them well. Great OKRs are customer-centric, inspirational, concrete, and actionable. This class teaches how to write great OKRs that achieve all of that, and that keep the customer at the center of your organization’s efforts.

item.title: Professional Scrum Master - AI Essentials
item.description:
Practical AI Techniques to Strengthen Scrum Master Capabilities and Empower their Teams

AI has become a core capability in product delivery and is transforming every role. Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches have a key part to play in the use of AI and introducing AI to teams, products and organizations, acting as a catalyst for change. Through the proper use of AI tools, Scrum Masters, their teams and organization become more effective.
